id.about_hero_subtitle: Panduan dzikir pagi, petang, dan wirid ba'da shalat sesuai hadits shahih. Dilengkapi pelacak kebiasaan harian dan analisis 90 hari.
id.about_footer_info: Dibuat dengan ❤️ untuk Ummah • Lisensi Open Source (MIT)
id.about_feature1_desc: Penghitung dzikir responsif dengan umpan balik suara ketukan mekanis, getaran haptic berinterval, dan mode layar tetap menyala.
id.about_feature2_desc: Visualisasi aktivitas harian melalui heatmap 90 hari, pencapaian streak, serta pencatatan target kebiasaan baik harian.
id.about_feature3_desc: Tersedia teks Arab, latin, dan terjemahan dzikir pagi, petang, dan wirid shalat. Anda juga dapat membuat dan menyunting dzikir kustom.
id.about_feature4_desc: Data tersimpan sepenuhnya secara lokal di peranti Anda (IndexedDB/localStorage) dengan dukungan backup & restore data dalam bentuk JSON.
id.about_licenses_subtitle: TasbihKu dibangun dengan menghargai karya komunitas sumber terbuka.
id.about_license_idb_desc: Penyimpanan data lokal berbasis IndexedDB berkecepatan tinggi.
id.about_license_google_sans_desc: Tipografi modern antarmuka dan angka digital.
id.about_license_amiri_desc: Tipografi Arab klasik Naskh untuk teks Al-Qur'an dan Hadits.
id.about_license_m3_desc: Bahasa desain Material 3 Expressive, palet warna, dan elevasi.
id.about_license_lucide_desc: Ikon garis pelengkap untuk indikator dan simbol.
id.about_license_mechvibes_desc: Efek audio ketukan mekanis keyboard CherryMX Red.
id.about_license_vite_vitest_desc: Bundler modern Vite, Vitest unit test, dan Playwright E2E.
id.about_license_hadith_desc: Shahih Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidzi, An-Nasa'i & Kemenag RI.
id.about_lang_switcher_desc: Pilih bahasa utama aplikasi (akan tersimpan otomatis)

en.about_hero_subtitle: Authentic morning, evening, and post-prayer dzikir guide according to sahih hadiths. Equipped with daily habit tracker and 90-day analytics.
en.about_footer_info: Made with ❤️ for the Ummah • Open Source License (MIT)
en.about_feature1_desc: Responsive dzikir counter with mechanical click sound feedback, interval haptic vibration, and screen awake mode.
en.about_feature2_desc: Visualise daily activities through a 90-day heatmap, streak achievements, and daily habit target tracking.
en.about_feature3_desc: Arabic text, transliteration, and translation for morning, evening, and post-prayer dzikir. You can also create and edit custom dzikirs.
en.about_feature4_desc: Data is stored entirely locally on your device (IndexedDB/localStorage) with backup & restore support in JSON format.
en.about_licenses_subtitle: TasbihKu is built with gratitude to the open-source community.
en.about_license_google_sans_desc: Modern interface variable and monospace typography.
en.about_license_amiri_desc: Classical Arabic Naskh typeface for Quranic and Hadith recitations.
en.about_license_m3_desc: Material 3 Expressive design language, tonal palette, and elevation.
en.about_license_symbols_desc: Application system iconography and navigation symbols.
en.about_license_lucide_desc: Clean outline icons for indicators and utility symbols.
en.about_license_mechvibes_desc: CherryMX Red mechanical keyboard tactile tap audio pack.
en.about_license_vite_vitest_desc: Vite bundler, Vitest test runner, and Playwright E2E suite.
en.about_license_hadith_desc: Sahih Al-Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi, An-Nasa'i & Kemenag RI.
